claim: Replacing non-GLU FFNs by parameter-matched GLU FFNs decreases empirical NTK condition numbers in ViT and GPT-2 architectures (Figure 3).

official_code.missing_capability: The official release contains no GPT-2 NTK implementation or Figure-3 raw CSV.

machine_contract.ntk: Exact scalar-output Jacobian Gram over all FFN parameters.
machine_contract.pass: For every architecture/pair, GLU wins at least 3/4 paired seeds and the geometric mean condition-number ratio is below one; paired FFN parameter counts differ by at most 0.5%.
